<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/content.ts -->
<!--
  The top of a post page: category, title, excerpt, the author line and an optional wide cover. Axes: layout
  (start, center), cover (show, hide), meta (full, short), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";

export type PostHeaderProps = {
  id: string;
  post: Post;
  labels: PostLabels;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  layout?: "start" | "center";
  cover?: "show" | "hide";
  meta?: "full" | "short";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import Pill from "../components/pill.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  post,
  labels,
  level = 1,
  layout = "start",
  cover = "show",
  meta = "full",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<PostHeaderProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="post.title"
    :lead="post.excerpt"
    :heading="{ level }"
    :align="layout"
    :tone="tone"
    :media="{ show: ((cover as string) === 'show') }"
  >
    <Group
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      :justify="(((layout as string) === 'center') ? 'center' : 'start')"
      class="flex-wrap"
      data-testid="post-meta"
    >
      <MediaFrame :alt="post.author" ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
        {{ post.author }}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ post.date }}
      </Text>
      <Text v-if="((meta as string) === 'full')" size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ tpl(labels.minutes, post.minutes) }}
      </Text>
      <Pill tone="blue">
        {{ post.category }}
      </Pill>
    </Group>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="post.title" ratio="21/9" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
